interface.shortDescription: Create, colour and publish print-aware colouring books and pattern collections.
interface.longDescription: Kaleidara is an OpsPocket creative publishing workflow for ChatGPT and Codex. Plan mandalas, colouring pages, colour-by-numbers books, pattern collections and relevant book covers with visible production decisions, sourced inspiration, print-aware checks and clear output states. The repository includes create_book_cover for a branded, high-resolution 2:3 front-cover generation brief with title hierarchy, subject relevance and natural, psychedelic or DMT-inspired palette direction. It also includes create_color_by_numbers_set for 2–4 deliberately different compositions, with distinct poses, viewpoints or environments, natural colour logic for real creatures and objects, or controlled psychedelic/DMT-inspired palettes, plus numbered-region and matching-key requirements. The reverse-page specification includes a large sourced quotation block and eight colour-test cubes. The self-hostable Apps SDK/MCP foundation validates requests, estimates billable cost, submits real provider jobs, polls status and supports cancellation. Provider credentials remain server-side. The live MCP endpoint is not hosted by this repository, and final KDP PDF, spine, deterministic segmentation and book-export work still require separate implementation and visual QA. It also contains a KDP metadata engine: create_book_title builds and validates the Amazon KDP title, subtitle, series, cover-copy block and seven backend keyword strings before any artwork exists, and validate_kdp_metadata enforces KDP's 200-character combined limit, the no-word-more-than-twice rule, the prohibited-term list and the keyword slot limits. The cover can never drift from the dashboard metadata, because KDP cross-checks the words printed on a cover against the Title and Subtitle fields, and a mismatch is the most common silent rejection.
